steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: What time is it?

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Four o'clock. That's the billionth time you've asked.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: I'm in a hurry! Aren't you?

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Calm down. Why hurry? They're already hustling over from the landship. If they just make it safe and sound, we can thank all we can.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Seriously, how do they make it from the landship in three days? Kinda impressive, landship.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: You've never been to Rhodes Island's ship?

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Nope. The fare for this wasn't cheap, and I still have a pile on my plate.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: The landship has this kind of large floating vessel. Moves really fast too. Bet you've never seen it, huh.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Floating? Like, a car that floats?

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: It sure isn't a car... I don't actually know the exact name myself.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Ohh, it's the kind those old Casters pilot in their towers, the really advanced kind that can drift through the air, is it?

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Not that either!

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Okay, you stop guessing. I haven't seen it much, and I can't explain it too well. Take one look at it and you'll get it.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: If you're this bored, give the car another check. We're squeezed for time getting back already. No wrong turns.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Fine, fine, fine... you're the boss, it's your call.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Come to mention it, who've we got coming from the landship?

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: You've never even been there. You wouldn't know any names if I told you.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: We're filing an emergency application here. No matter who it is, it's gotta be one of the Medical Department's best.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: We're in pretty deep here. What kind of best are we talking about?

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: No need to fuss about it.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Oh, here they come.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: That's... a pretty fierce vehicle. The landship has stuff like that? Color me surprised.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Knock it off. Get ready to meet 'em.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Welcome to Leithanien. I'm Feraligus, officer in charge of the local branch office. Just call me Ferl.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Good to meet you. I'm Landship Medic Operator Sussurro, and these are my assistants.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: What are you staring for? Where's your hellos?

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Oh! Oh! Right.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: I'm the branch office's... driver... wait, uh, I'm an Operator at the local branch office, codename Piston.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Situation's complicated, and we're pressed for time. Let's all get in the car for now.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Regarding the details of the emergency situation, we've stamped all the information. Best look over it while we're driving.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Alright, thank you very much.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: We've also brought some equipment, so if you could move that into the car, please.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Al... alright.
Two hours later

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Let me see the second file.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Look over this report for me. Confirm if there's any additional kit we need to prepare.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Right away.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: (Hey!)

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: What? Why so secret?

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Keep it down!

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Didn't you say they sent their best? Why's this little lady leading them?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Watch what you say, kid. I'll knock your bonus.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: When'd you learn to judge people by appearances like an idiot? Did you get nothing from the employee handbook?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Rein your mouth in if you don't get it. She's one of the elite from Medical Department.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Okay, okay, okay... my bad, my bad.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Ferl, sir.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: I've finished reading through the files, and I have a few questions.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: According to the descriptions, most of those requiring medical aid here are not infected with Oripathy?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: That's right. The account from the Leithanian government is that a Catastrophe wrecked a city and caused casualties, but the actual situation's more messy than that.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Was it a lapse on a Catastrophe Messenger's part?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Currently... doesn't look like it.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: There were no problems with the Catastrophe evac op. At least, nothing cropped up during the whole course of things.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: The one issue is... nobody knew about the needlefly nests under the path of the Catastrophe. At least ten counted, huge ones.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: That village there started shifting nomadic beforehand, but there were over a hundred needleflies escaping the Catastrophe that ran straight into the migration team...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Needleflies? The meter-plus carnivorous insects?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Over a hundred??

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: ...I see...

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Do we have a casualty count yet?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Leithanian government sources haven't given clear figures.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: It's been two days, and they still haven't produced any conclusions...

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Which indicates they're temporarily unable to enumerate casualties.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Estate guards brought a hell of a lot of wounded to a nearby town, but we weren't in time to check one by one.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Does the branch office still have adequate medical supplies? How much antidote for needlefly poison do we have in reserve? How well have surgery facilities been maintained?

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: How about the mobilization of other local first-aid teams to the area? I need this information, and it's not included in the files.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Medical supplies-wise, still plenty for the time being.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Local powers began first-aid work straight away, and after getting the commission, the R.I. branch office received ample emergency rescue supplies too.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Medical facilities are in alright shape, but it's not automatic, and we're desperately short of people.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: The town doctors are pretty well-trained, but lack emergency response experience, and most have never seen a disaster of this scale in their lives.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: The branch office's town isn't highly populous, so there's only three small clinics in all, and even fewer doctors who can perform surgery.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Plenty of injured can't hold through to the operating table.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: We're accommodating a lot of refugees at the office right now. The outlook's not happy at all.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Moreover, given the whole mess, we've been unable to sort patients.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Some of them we've been sent are Infected... and after Infected pass away... you get what I mean.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: There's still some way to go. Take a rest for now.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: There's quite a few here already.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: By now, the injured should all be transferred near the branch office. The other office staff ought to be in the middle of handling them.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Piston, you wait here. There'll be supply cars from other stations in a bit. You catch them.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: I just sit here and wait? Is that gonna work?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: This is your first time on this sort of mission. The on-site situation is more brutal than you think. Just sit tight here, and receive and allocate the medical supplies.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: You're kidding me. If that bunch of girls can go, what's a big man like me afraid of.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: ...Brat.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Fine. Don't say I didn't warn you.

a.text: In the town square, a space not that large to begin with, injured fill the ground, their numbers far beyond the limits of what medical treatment can process.
It's the third day since this calamity occurred, and the stench of festering wounds and exposed blood chokes the air.

steps.name: Unrecognizable Injured
steps.text: Water... I need water...

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Papa! Papa!

steps.name: Mutilated Injured
steps.text: *cough*... *cough*...

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Someone get over here! This Infected's almost done for!

steps.name: Regular Injured
steps.text: Infected! D-Don't come near me.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: What are you doing here? Get back to the treatment area, quick.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Guards! Guards! Anyone!

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: ...oh, my god... this...

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: It's even worse than I thought.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: When I came yesterday, the courtyard over there was still a cargo station from the local council. Now it's been appropriated as a normal patient treatment area.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: They don't have enough doctors. Only the most seriously injured get prioritized for the treatment rooms.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: What's the situation... with those lying on the ground?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: These are all Infected by my reckoning. This town's pretty small, and has no Infected quarter, and they can't keep them in the same place as the regular people...

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: But they can't just be strewn across the plaza. Operator Ferl, how much space can you make in the office warehouse?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: I'm arranging to get everything moved out. Shouldn't be much of a problem.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: We still need a space to hold the injured Infected. Ideally, somewhere that can be isolated...

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Then we can empty out the operator dorms. That'll need a bit of time.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: I'll leave it to you.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Team one to the warehouse, and inspect the condition of Infected.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Teams two and three with me, and move all equipment into the operating room!

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: I'll have to leave classifying the injured to you, along with the corresponding zones they go to.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Al—Alright.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: I—I'll pitch in too.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Good. You come help me out. Carry these few indoors with me.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Before we use Originium Arts to expedite wound healing, we must confirm they're all cleared and cleaned.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: If the wounds aren't severe, then hold off using Arts as much as possible. A doctor's strength is our most precious resource right now; only reasonable allocation can allow us to save even more lives.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Deal with this bed first! This patient is critical!

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: (Gasps)

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Needleflies bit his arm off as he was protecting his family. He was unconscious by the time he got to us.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: He's Infected, but his illness is stable.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: And his arm...? Do we still have his shorn limb?

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Wound is already bacterially infected. Left hand also has visible broad lesions. It will likely still require partial amputation.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: At this rate... both his arms are going to be...

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Go and assist team two. Leave this end to me.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Bless you!

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Don't lose focus. Prepare for Infected emergency treatment.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Patient's surface crystallization is located in the throat. Inspecting blood.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Watch his wrist scales, and ready Savra-specialized scalpels.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: This room's still too dark. Piston, sir, check the condition of the generator.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: On it!
Three hours later
Within the office infirmary, operation on the acutely injured still hasn't stopped.

steps.name: Wounded
steps.text: Doctor... am I hopeless... Doctor, you have to tell me...

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Internal bleeding relatively severe. Change the bottle on the blood suction machine.

steps.name: Wounded
steps.text: I'm begging you... I'm begging you, Doctor, take this ring... take it to my wife, I'm begging you...

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: You're going to live. Stay with me.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Gauze out! Need more!

steps.name: Wounded
steps.text: Don't... Don't lie to me, I know...

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Don't speak! You're going to live, I guarantee it!

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Hold down here for me, and I'll suture.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hydrogen peroxide's out! Someone go to the warehouse and bring a box!

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Piston, sir!

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: On it! I-I'll go right away.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Bleeding stopped. The rest is yours. I'm checking on the other beds.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Over here! Doctor! One just came in, they're on the brink!

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: I'm coming.

a.text: The man laid on the stretcher gasps a mottled breath, his state almost too miserable to look at.
A giant gash is torn across his abdomen, the cavity's contents exposed until now to Leithanien's frigid winds.
Parts of his organs have already been contaminated by needlefly toxin, the scent of it nauseating.
Yet his consciousness is still fully with him—it may be the poison is stimulating his nerves, strangely colored bodily fluids dripping incessantly from his mouth and nostrils.

steps.name: Moribund Injured
steps.text: *cough*... ngh...

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Thoracoabdominal injury. Open wound to abdomen.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Push him in, prioritize him for treatment, and incise his esophagus and windpipe!

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: ...oh, god... oh, god...

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: ...this...

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Don't stop! There are still other patients!

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Look for any internal organ damage! Find any points of bleeding in his peritoneum! Quickly!

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: ...I... I'm a little—

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Sorry... I... I.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: That's alright, you did well. Head outside and rest for now.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Thank you... thank you...

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: ...this is too much...

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Ulghh...

a.text: The young Leithanian's strained nerves are finally relaxed for a moment.
After profusely vomiting in an alley behind the infirmary, he feels both a weight off his back, and an immense regret of the extra bun he ate this morning.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: ...Do the landship guys... see this stuff all the time?

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: ...urgh... not again... urlgh...

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: You okay?

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: I'm alright... I'm alright, I'm just not that used to all this...

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Here, a towel. Wipe your face.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: ...urghh... kinda embarrassing. Didn't think I'd be the first on the scene who couldn't keep going.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: It's alright. You haven't been doing bad.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: You're telling me that didn't suck?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: You went and volunteered to help, held out for half the day, and you're no Medic Operator. I figured you'd give in after half an hour.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: That girl... no, that Medic Operator. She's something major alright.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Hah. What did I tell you before, huh? They're from the landship, from HQ. They're the best.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: That Medic Op, Sussurro, was there for the Palermo incident a few years back. Don't underestimate her.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: The Palermo incident? Oh... that big one that stirred up Siracusa?

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: It was an Originium mine explosion, right? I remember a whole lot of civs got infected bad. Couldn't prepare enough treatment. Led to a huge number of acute Infected dead... I think half the city was on the edge of collapsing.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: That's what hell on earth truly is. Imagine it, a huge breakout of acute Infected, people's remains everywhere, already starting to disintegrate, whole air full of active dust. It's a terrifying scene.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Almost everyone who went through Palermo got left with heavy psychological trauma.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: And to our Medic Op here, the scene today is barely anything.

a.text: The young Leithanian falls silent, crouched on the ground, window of the Rhodes Island branch office above his head.
He looks out towards the plaza.
Not far away, the people in the zone for minorly injured throng about.
And on the other side of the rigged-up divider wall, the infirmary is still a battlefield.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Forget it. I'll go back in to help.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Calm down first.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: You don't want to throw up in there, that'll just give them all trouble.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Fair.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: If you want to help out so bad, go to the reception area and see if there's any communication work. Check to see if any other supply cars arrived while you're there.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Okay... I'm going now!

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: ...Hah, brat.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Phew... Heavens...

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Ah, Doctor. How's it gone?

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: We owe you for this. Most of the injured are stable, and now it's just up to the lord's end for follow-up arrangements.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: I used to doubt you were a medical company at all. I really am... truly am... sorry I thought that.

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: Thank you, thank you so much, I... I can't find any better words right now. If you hadn't saved us, the casualties and the accompanying disaster would've been unimaginable.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: No, I... I'm just an errand boy... um...

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: How are the Medic Operators? Are they on break?

steps.name: Local Doctor
steps.text: I'm not too sure where they've gone either—I thought you Rhodes Islanders would've had a better idea than me. I see your dormitory's been used to rest the injured?

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Then I know. You go rest up for now.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Cap, HQ's sent med...

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Shh, keep it quiet!

a.text: The elder Operator points towards the other end of the room, where a few reinforcement Medic Operators who rushed over from other offices are inspecting the conditions of the injured in the warehouse.
Their steps quietly shuffle back and forth between the patients, trying their best not to make noise.
Behind them, other Medic Operators who've fought through the whole day are sat against the wall, spent after over ten hours of consecutive operation.
That delicately framed doctor is huddled together with all the others, sleeping in a corner of the room.
In the quiet warehouse, the only noise is that of people breathing, respiring, but her light snores are distinct to pick out among them.

Her uniform and medical shielding equipment are covered in a mess, blood plasma, tissue fluid and indistinguishable fragments of flesh having left copious stains, the rancid scent having still not dispersed. It doesn't bother her, though, as she's fallen asleep just like that.
A multitude of breaths accompany her snores, rough and heavy, light and soft, among which are the breaths of the many she pulled back from death's door today.
Once tomorrow comes, these people will all thank her, and they'll thank that delicate doctor for the rest of their lives.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: If something's up, we'll talk outside.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: They... nah, let them rest.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: How's the reception area?

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: No problems. Lord's people are all here, and they've shifted off the first batch of the lightly injured.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: As long as it's all going well.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: If there's something you wanna say, say it. Quit stopping and starting.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Not much... just, I feel like...

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: You want to resign?

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: No, I just feel like I've gotten to know this part of Rhodes Island's work a bit deeper... pretty much. Just a bit.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Hahaha...

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: It's good to have enthusiasm. Since you still do, go check on how our medical supply consumption's doing.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Make two reports, one for the office records, and one to hand to the local government tomorrow morning.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Okay... I'm going now.
Four days later

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Everything packed up?

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Yes, no problem.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: I'm back, I'm back! Almost didn't make it!

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: What did you go off to do?!

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Ah! This is the stuff you asked me to buy for you, right, Dr. Sussurro? Got it all here.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: This much?

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: *clears throat*... These are books for Dr. Kal'tsit, and this is a souvenir for Dr. Gavial.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: What's this, snacks?

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Those are a... little present for the Doctor.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Doctor? You mean... that Doctor?

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: To keep things brief, say hello to Dr. Kal'tsit and the Doctor for me.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Alright, no problem.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: And finally, I hope you have a good journey, and make it back safe.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Thank you very much. We'll see you next time.

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: They're off.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Alright. Time to head back and do some work. We've still got a mountain of reports to write.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Piston
steps.text: Maybe I oughta look for a work opportunity, head to the Rhodes Island landship and see for myself... Feels like it's all amazing people over there.

steps.name: Feraligus
steps.text: Sure. But finish the work you've got first, and then you can mull it over.
